items.source:
Note: Implementations should not close the given InputStream
(or any decorators of that InputStream) but rather leave this up
to the caller.
items.translation: 注意：实现不应关闭给定的 InputStream（或其任何装饰器），而应将其留由调用者处理。

items.source: Read (assemble) an object of type T from the given byte array.
items.translation: 从给定的字节数组中读取（组装）类型为 T 的对象。

items.source: IOException - in case of deserialization failure
items.translation: `IOException` - 在反序列化失败的情况下

items.source: A strategy interface for converting from data in an InputStream to an Object.
items.translation: 用于将 InputStream 中的数据转换为对象的策略接口。

items.source: Read (assemble) an object of type T from the given InputStream.
items.translation: 从给定的 InputStream 中读取（组装）类型为 T 的对象。

items.source: IOException - in case of errors reading from the stream
items.translation: IOException - 在从流读取时发生错误的情况下

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。

items.source: Gary Russell, Mark Fisher, Juergen Hoeller
